original_comment: 6. The manuscript currently lacks physical mechanism diagnostics and sensitivity analyses, which require supplementation. Specifically, (1) the current study does not explain why harmonization reduces the core–ring residual correlation from 0.885 to 0.554. As demonstrated in Table S8, core and ring exhibit significantly distinct hour offsets before sunset (3.68 K versus 3.06 K when h = −3), which indicates that the underlying mechanism is that differential time-varying correction eliminates the shared error structure. However, the manuscript only notes that this observation "does not identify causal mechanisms" without further discussion, and does not carry out component decomposition analysis across dimensions including hour, view zenith, DQF tier, cloud screening, and emissivity/atmospheric inputs. Furthermore, the typical UHI contrast magnitude (~2–5 K) is not compared with the cross-platform discrepancies (~0.6–0.9 K), making it difficult for readers to assess its practical impact. The authors should add these diagnostics or at least quantify the associated concerns.
status: Quantitative diagnostics completed within scope; physical attribution partial
changes: Independently reproduced residual correlation and within-/between-hour covariance, differential offsets, hour and geometry strata, strict DQF/common support, sampled cloud screening, native ancillary metadata and ground sensitivities. Strict results explicitly concern Tucson, South Valley and Albuquerque only (215 hours/21 transitions); geographic/view-angle dependence and conditional bootstrap are explicit. Compared discrepancy RMSE with actual reference contrast medians, retaining 38.2%/44.2% aggregate scale ratios. Main3.5now explicitly reports both unfavorable21-transition/three-city corrections. CompactS5shows all20historical/modernhourbins and bothreferenceVZAstrata, including all8unfavorablemodernhourgains. REVIEWER_DIAGNOSTICS.md provides21verified exact-filelinks.
remaining: Statistical covariance accounting is not unique physical attribution. Ground-emissivity perturbations do not alter actual ABI retrieval inputs. Cloud diagnostics cover selected scans on eight dates; strict quality is not 75-city robustness.
